storyboard.spokenMeaning: You keep reshaping your answers for an audience that gives nothing back, so the performance is pointless and you should stop.
storyboard.viewerTakeaway: Every self-edit cuts you down to a stub at the crowd's gates — drop the gates, hold one full-length direction, and it is what gets remembered.

visualNarrative.action: Headline reveals line-by-line upper-left; below it a taut line draws from the left margin tagged 'YOUR MIND', with one aperture gate labeled 'EVERYONE' waiting ahead.
visualNarrative.meaning: The answer starts whole and comes from the self; the crowd is staged as a gate your line must pass through.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Headline at 8% left margin, upper-left third; one horizontal line in the lower corridor with origin tick and 34px tag 'YOUR MIND'; one hairline aperture gate; ~55% empty dark field.

visualNarrative.action: The line slides through gate 1 and emerges shorter, a dim fragment dropping off its tail; gate 2 'PEOPLE' fades in ahead and clips a second fragment the same way.
visualNarrative.meaning: Matching the asker is subtraction: each accommodation removes part of the answer rather than refining it.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Line loses ~25% length per pass; two grey fragments scale to zero and dissolve; gates reveal with staggered fade; no glow, no counters.

visualNarrative.action: At gate 3 'APPLAUSE' only a short stub emerges; it dims toward black and sags off-axis while the label stamps: 'EVERYONE FED — NOTHING LEFT', gold on 'NOTHING'.
visualNarrative.meaning: Disillusionment clears into fatigue: the crowd is fed and what remains of you no longer means anything.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Stub at ~15% length, luminance ~30%; 34px uppercase label under the track above the subtitle band; gold only on 'NOTHING'.

visualNarrative.action: The gates hold empty a beat, then a fresh full-length stroke draws at constant height from the left margin, ignoring every aperture and passing through the row uncut.
visualNarrative.meaning: The imperative made visible: stop entering their gates — one unedited direction held at full length.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Straight gold-tinted line crossing the whole gate row; gates dim to hairline; fragments gone; empty bands above and below.

visualNarrative.action: The stroke exits frame right; hold on dimmed gates with the line 'HOLD ONE DIRECTION — THIS IS WHAT GETS REMEMBERED', gold on 'REMEMBERED'.
visualNarrative.meaning: Resolve: what you refuse to cut for them is the only version anyone retains.
visualNarrative.visualEvidence: Gates and stub at low luminance; one 34px uppercase label; large negative space preserved.

storyboard.compositionIntent: Top-text-bottom-object: headline occupies the upper-left third at 8% margin; the lower mid corridor holds the horizontal gate track with origin tag and stamp label, clear of the subtitle band. Travel stays in one corridor, leaving ~55% negative space and open right and bottom bands.
visualEvidence: One line loses visible length at each of three labeled gates, shedding dissolving fragments
Stub drops to near-dark with label 'EVERYONE FED — NOTHING LEFT', gold only on 'NOTHING'
Straight gold-tinted stroke crosses the whole gate row uncut and exits frame right
Gates end as dimmed hairlines — no fills, glows, counters or readouts
forbiddenInterpretations: a crowd, clapping hands, cheering figures or applause sound-waves
counters, tallies, gauges or percentage readouts of approval
scissors, blades, shredded paper or literal cutting tools
dashboard cards, UI chrome, seat rows or grid-filled bottom band
camera shake, glitch or gratuitous zoom on the final stroke
storyboard.noveltyIntent: Instead of lines dying at a circle's rim, the audience becomes a row of labeled apertures: your answer passes through and is physically shortened at each gate, so self-editing reads as loss. The resolve line neither bends nor dodges — it refuses the gates and crosses uncut, making 'hold one direction' a measurable property: full length preserved.
